ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi Admin Permission Assigned To Account Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "system" and "permission" flags in order to assign admin permissions to an account.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*system.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ permission\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ set.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Admin.*")))
